ubivīs

adverb · Wiktionary

anywhere you like, anywhere at all

In this lexicon

  • anywhere

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Fam. 6.1.1: nēmō sit quīn ubivīs quam ibi ubi est esse mālit (Lewis & Short); Cic. Att. 14.22.2: ubivīs tūtius quam in senātū (Lewis & Short)
